title: UI Panels
intro: Build a working scripted_gui panel on the canvas — no scripting. One token drives every name it generates.
previewNotice: Showcase feature: panels are included in your export, but usually will not appear in-game on their own.
previewNoticeDetail: A panel only shows up once something in the mod points at it. With the default context type it has to be attached to a decision category, which this workbench does not set up for you.
deleteConfirm: Delete this panel? The exported .gui/.txt/loc entries will disappear from the next export.
emptyBody: Create a panel with a token on the left, or select one to edit its canvas, bindings and naming contract.
parentWindowHint: decision_category panels embed in the decision UI — a parent window is usually unnecessary.
emptyHeroDesc: Custom scripted_gui panels: lay out controls on a canvas and the names get wired up for you. Start with your first panel.
